Cin7CoreAPIKeyCredential.title: Cin7 Core API Key
Cin7CoreAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Cin7 Core, open Integrations > API and create an API application. Paste its Account ID and API Application Key. Each company has a different Account ID; both values are secret. The connection reads your company from GET /me. Enable access to the resources your workflow reads or changes.
